title: The stickers, iv
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: Thursday. The reply. Wood writes to the sticker people. The strip shows the envelope going in the mailbox and the flag going up, and, for once, the letter: one line.

panels.composition: The garage table. WOOD writing a short letter. BARNABY II, recovered, beneath.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a man writing a very short letter at a drafting table with a small dog beneath

panels.composition: The letter. One line, in the display face: 'The dog ate the sample. He is not for sale either.' Signed with the gull.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, close-up of a short hand-lettered note on white paper signed with a tiny gull mark
image.notes: Letter after: 'The dog ate the sample. He is not for sale either.' The gull, not the scruff — the old mark, once, on purpose.

panels.composition: The roadside mailbox. The envelope going in. The flag up.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a man putting an envelope into a roadside mailbox and raising the red flag, a small dog at his feet

panels.composition: Walking back. The pup light on his three legs. The mailbox behind with its flag up like a small salute.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a man and a small three-legged dog walking away from a roadside mailbox whose red flag is raised, no words

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; Sundays wet-on-wet; 2019: the Sunday drawn to a smaller grid
art.palette: ink and one tone; Sundays gray-green, fog, rust; 2020: ochre and slate arriving

notes: 'He is not for sale either.' Signed with the gull, once.
